decision.question: Which storage format should the first production save system use?

objective.primary: Ship a maintainable single-player save system that remains easy to debug and migrate.

goals.text: Save data should be easy for developers to inspect while the game is evolving.
The format should support future save-version migrations.

constraints.text: The game is offline single-player in v1.
Implementation and maintenance burden must stay low.

unknowns: Final save size is not yet known.
